name: Ripper
source:
Hobbies: Wanton slaughter, hunting
Likes: Fun
Dislikes: Boredom

The major antagonist of Code: Embryo. An insane sadistic serial killer, he has murdered a large number of people and disposed of them haphazardly and is known for being an SS-ranked criminal. More crazed and psychopathic than one could believe, Ripper is nothing short of twisted and sadistic. Despite possessing a Crystal and being utterly devoid of any positive emotion, Ripper is fully mentally capable, being clearly able to devise cunning strategies to give him an advantage in combat. Ripper only gets any real joy out of his opponents helplessness and scared emotions, and in order to help strike fear and panic into his prey's hearts, he also possesses multiple bombs that are molotov-like in their design as they ignite the area around them.
